children: On October 30, 2026, Cyngn notified Nasdaq that, after director Karen Macleod's resignation takes effect following the November 3, 2026 annual meeting, its Audit Committee will have two members and fail to meet Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2)(A). The company expects to have until the earlier of its next annual meeting or November 3, 2027, to regain compliance by appointing a qualified independent director.
